messages:
maya (partnerships): Heads-up: CipherKey (hardware KMS vendor) asked to fast-track marketplace listing. they support HSM-backed wrapping, SCIM, and SAML. want a small pilot and joint announcement in late June.

thomas (security): Good to hear. must confirm BYOK envelope flow and HSM attestation. ask for signed cert chain + firmware versions. also want replay protection and signed audit events.

alejandra (product): Product needs exact feature list for the listing and any beta flags. also need vendor logo + 1-paragraph blurb by EOW.

maya (partnerships): vendor says assets available Thu. requesting a staging run tomorrow afternoon. can eng create a tenant?

sam (eng): I can do tomorrow 3pm PT. what should I validate? my list: wrap/unwrap, rotation, SCIM create/delete, SAML login + role mapping, and audit events.

thomas (security): add: latency samples for wrap op, nonce/timestamp replay check, and proof that rotation rewraps previous secrets.

maya (partnerships): legal flagged co-marketing embargo. proposing embargo lift = 2026-06-28 00:00 PT. legal will review copy.

alejandra (product): mark BYOK as "beta" until rotation test passes. i'll draft listing copy and set feature flags.

sam (eng): infra-bot please provision ck-partner-stg-02.

infra-bot: provisioning started: tenant ck-partner-stg-02. invite sent to cipherkey@vendor.com. creds expire in 72h. link: https://staging.console.redwood/tenants/ck-partner-stg-02

maya (partnerships): Action items: 1) sam to run staging tests tomorrow 3pm PT 2) thomas to publish acceptance checklist by EOD 3) legal to confirm embargo (maya->legal) 4) alejandra to prepare listing draft. i'll run a sync after tests.

thomas (security): Draft checklist (short):
- Envelope wrap/unwrap API success codes + errors
- HSM attestation cert + firmware list
- Rotation test: rewrap + seamless decrypt
- Replay protection: nonce/timestamp verified
- Audit: append-only signed events for wrap/unwrap/rotate
- Latency: median wrap <60ms, p99 <180ms in staging
- SCIM + SAML functional tests

sam (eng): Got it. will paste HAR and timing summary after run.

infra-bot: cipherkey@vendor.com joined tenant ck-partner-stg-02.
